job.title: Cutting and Creasing Machine Operative
job.description:
Cutting and Creasing Operator in Crewe

Salary: Up to £39,500 per annum (or up to £20.25 per hour), depending on experience
Job Type: Permanent, Full-Time
Working Pattern: On-Site, Shift-Based

Are you an experienced Cutting and Creasing Operator looking for a skilled, hands-on role with a business that values your expertise? Appointments Personnel is recruiting for a Cutting and Creasing Operator in Crewe on behalf of our client, with an immediate start available. This is a technical die-cutting and print finishing role for someone who already knows the folding carton industry and is confident running sheet-fed cutting and creasing equipment.

The Role
As a Cutting and Creasing Operator, you'll set up and run cutting and creasing machinery to a consistently high standard. This is a technical position that calls for accuracy and a sharp eye for detail, not general machine minding. Run lengths vary widely, so you'll be comfortable with regular make-readies during a shift and with working closely alongside colleagues in other teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Set up, run and adjust cutting and creasing machines to specification.
  • Carry out multiple make-readies per shift, with run lengths from 2,500 to 100,000 sheets.
  • Check work throughout each run to keep quality and accuracy high.
  • Keep production moving efficiently while minimising waste.
  • Work with other teams to keep jobs flowing smoothly through the site.
  • Support colleagues with using the equipment whenever needed.

Skills and Experience
To be successful in this Cutting and Creasing Operator role, you'll ideally have:

  • Proven, hands-on experience operating cutting and creasing equipment within the folding carton industry.
  • Experience on Bobst, Brausse or Heidelberg machines.
  • Strong technical ability and confidence carrying out make-readies.
  • Excellent accuracy and attention to detail.
  • A positive, team-focused approach and good communication skills.
  • The willingness to share your knowledge and support other operators.

Salary and Benefits

  • Salary of up to £39,500 per annum (or up to £20.25 per hour), depending on experience.
  • Permanent, full-time position.
  • 26 days' holiday per year, plus statutory bank holidays.
  • A genuinely skilled role where your experience is valued.

Working Hours and Location

  • Full-time, Monday to Friday, on alternating shifts: 6am to 1.30pm and 1.30pm to 9pm.
  • Based on-site in Crewe.

How to Apply
If you're an experienced Cutting and Creasing Operator and this Cutting and Creasing Operator job in Crewe sounds like the right fit, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today with your up-to-date CV.

job.title: Management Accountant
job.description:
Location: Stoke-On-Trent
Working Pattern: Full-time, office-based
Salary: Up to £48,000
Sector: Finance & Accounting

Are you an experienced finance professional looking for a role where you can take ownership of financial reporting and support a wider finance team?

We are recruiting for a Management Accountant to join an established business in Stoke-On-Trent. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong financial accounting experience who enjoys analysing financial performance, overseeing day-to-day finance operations and supporting colleagues across multiple locations.

Reporting to the Finance Director, you will oversee the day-to-day financial operations of the business, support the Finance Department and deliver accurate financial reporting to management. You will also work closely with an overseas office, supporting financial processes and ensuring company policies and procedures are followed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee day-to-day financial operations, including sales ledger, purchase ledger, nominal ledger and banking.

  • Manage and support the Finance Team, providing guidance and assistance where required.

  • Prepare monthly management accounts, financial reports and variance analysis.

  • Prepare and monitor cash flow forecasts.

  • Complete bank and balance sheet reconciliations across UK and overseas accounts.

  • Prepare, review and post manual journals.

  • Prepare and submit VAT returns within required deadlines.

  • Support year-end processing, audits and the preparation of statutory accounts.

  • Assist with annual budgeting and financial planning.

  • Oversee supplier payments, customer invoicing, credit control and account reconciliations.

  • Resolve financial queries with customers and suppliers.

  • Liaise with the overseas office to provide ongoing finance support.

  • Monitor internal controls and ensure accounting policies and procedures are followed.

About You

The successful candidate will have previous experience working within a finance department, with the ability to manage financial processes, analyse data and support a team effectively.

You will ideally have:

  • A recognised accounting qualification or be qualified by experience.

  • Experience managing a finance team and working collaboratively with colleagues.

  • Good knowledge of Sage 200.

  • Strong Excel skills and the ability to analyse financial information.

  • Experience working with multiple currencies.

  • A good understanding of management accounts, reconciliations and financial reporting.

  • Excellent organisational and time management skills, with the ability to meet deadlines.

  • Strong communication skills and a proactive, positive approach to work.

What's on Offer?

  • Salary up to £48,000 DOE .

  • A full-time, office-based position.

  • The opportunity to take ownership of key finance operations.

  • A varied role combining financial reporting, team management and international finance support.

If you are an experienced Management Accountant looking for your next opportunity, we would love to hear from you.

Are you detail-oriented with experience in manufacturing, engineering, testing or quality inspection? We’re looking for a Quality and Test Technician to join a busy engineering team in Ashbourne.

You’ll carry out mechanical, electrical and software testing, inspect in-build electrical wiring and maintain accurate records, working closely with Engineering, Production and Quality teams to resolve any issues and ensure products are ready for shipment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Operate and test equipment to ensure it performs correctly and meets customer requirements.

  • Complete accurate test reports and maintain inspection records, including updating the ERP system where required.

  • Capture photographic and video evidence of testing where necessary.
